display_name: 仿射混合恢复器：固定预测独立评分修复
description: 原版完成训练并固定两总体七视图，评分因缺少原始评分模块在连接真值前失败；仅对既有预测独立评分。
authorization: 原已授权两总体七视图正式评分；不重训、重预测或选模。

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI, CPU only, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty

data.representation: OriginalR07 clean/receivedIQ2x256/FIR64/main-image256/scalarnoise + source63000IQmu-fullC andF0variance. Everyrecord receives physical+detail+feature loss.
data.physical_ids_ref: R07train/physical_ids.npy roles.npy;validatedoriginalsourceLUcache IDs foralignment;officialMain source-disjoint viewindexes
data.validation_ref: ReuseVALIDATED_ONCE originalR07/capsule/split andsource-onlya3muC/f57variance. V1800 diagnostic804a586b motivates separation but never enters training/selection;no datahash/revalidation.
data.support_query_ref: No targettraining/support/PCD/unknownrole. OriginalMain two populations168000,all7perrowfixedbefore independenttruth.
data.actual_training_labels: Zero TX truth. Source simulator action/noise, source IQ/STFT and continuous frozen F0 output features only.
data.augmentation: Original fixed source R07 20 channel draws and repeat first 10; no target augmentation or fits.

permissions.query_use: 原两总体全部七视图、原候选/raw/DURA 决策固定后，原始 CPU scorer 对 opaque ID 关联 truth；无训练或目标拟合。
permissions.claim_scope: 仅原固定单 seed 与固定测试矩阵；测试已在研发中曝光，不称独立盲测。

checkpoint.initialization: 无模型加载：只读取父任务已固定预测及原始评分器。
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: 评分前核对两个总体、全部7视图、F0身份、物理 ID、三条读数、预测状态与原失败日志。
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: 父预测在原评分器缺模块前全部固定；无训练或查询拟合。
checkpoint.selection_rule: 固定父预测，全部维度一次评分；无重新预测或测试选模。

execution.gpu_policy: CPU only，CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES空；共享原 scorer 锁。
execution.stop_rule: 任一父预测/身份/场景不完整、原失败非缺模块、存在旧评分结果、输出碰撞或原评分器验证失败：保留产物停止。

metric_names: Same original Tri-SIG-TIME SSL default head: raw clean 145385/168000; each practical >=140345 and both populations clean maintained 111019/34366.
Per TX/RX/day, paired raw/DURA repairs/damage; matched original mixture only after both fixed complete matrices.
All 30 source logs including centered coefficient RMS, IQ correction NMSE, prior invariance, posterior residual, real gradients, training time and peak memory.

rows.purpose: 仅原冻结预测的独立 truth-last 评分
rows.scenario: 原 Main 两总体 clean 与六星地场景
rows.budget_ref: 零模型前向、零参数更新、零新预测；原有两个总体所有视图评分。

notes: 原版全部预测固定后评分因缺少 pamf_repl_view_shuffle 模块失败，失败发生在原 scorer 调用和 truth 读取之前。
原 score 失败记录和全部固定预测只读保留；新输出独占目录，采用原 F0 源 release 的评分器和共享评分锁。
源预测的候选、raw、DURA、原识别器、物理 ID 和两个总体七视图先校验，原 scorer 自身在连接 truth 前再校验矩阵。
